title: CFR 707 gravel bike build with weights

takeaways.text: Size-small parts weighed with removable hardware off: frame about 1,262 g, uncut fork 481 g, thru-axles about 76 g, one-piece bar/stem 398 g, seatpost 178 g, headset parts and spacers 144 g, seat clamp about 36–42 g.

Medium frame built with mechanical SRAM Rival, Vision Team 30 wheels and 700×43 mm tires; hoses and housing must be aligned untwisted before the lower headset cover goes on because the passage is too tight for them to cross.
Brake mounts are set for 160 mm rotors without adapters, so 140 mm rotors cannot be used; 180 mm needs an adapter, and the rear caliper needs 37 mm bolts.

disclosure: The description identifies the CFR707 build but does not establish ownership, product-supply terms or commercial relationships.
summary: A 2023 CFR707 build presentation with component-weight context. Build-specific values are not adopted as current catalog weights or specifications.
